composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An Idempotency-Key naming an already-created owner replays that owner (200) instead of
# creating a duplicate; otherwise the key is published for recording and the create proceeds.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  outputs:
    replay: respondReplay
    proceed: validate

respondReplay:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode against the city's region before any downstream work, so an
# out-of-range or malformed postcode is a 400.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registration date later than the server date (a 400), before it is
# defaulted or rolled onto a business day.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectDisposableEmail

# Reject a present, well-formed email whose domain is a disposable-email provider (a 400),
# after syntax has been validated and the address canonicalized.
rejectDisposableEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueHousehold

ensureUniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rollRegistrationDate

# Roll the effective date (supplied or defaulted) onto a business day before it drives the
# daily-limit count and the membership number's year segment.
rollRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RollRegistrationDateToBusinessDay
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHousehold

countHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Ceil the new owner's membership level at one above the current household maximum, before it
# is saved, so the create and later read responses report the capped level.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: detectPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft duplicate (same last name + postcode, different telephone) before saving, so the
# persisted owner — and the create/read responses — carry possibleDuplicate / possibleDuplicateOf.
detectPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DetectPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Register the saved owner under its Idempotency-Key (a no-op when none was supplied), so a
# later create repeating the key replays this owner via checkIdempotency.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific for the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; either form is accepted.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). When present it is appended to addressLine1 in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied it is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the
            normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth (ISO date). Optional; when supplied the owner's
            ageBand is derived from it relative to the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares
            its household (same last name and postcode), declaring it a genuine additional
            member rather than a duplicate. Only bypasses the duplicate block; the household
            link is assigned deterministically regardless. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                How to address the pet owner - the title followed by a space and the last
                name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Points start at 0 and accrue independently, +2 when an email address is present, +1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 once tenure reaches at least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from membershipPoints, 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted as 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so 1 July 2025 - 30 June 2026 is FY26).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode first (the region whose pinned range contains the postcode - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone

              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific for the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; either form is accepted.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). When present it is appended to addressLine1 in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied it is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the
            normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth (ISO date). Optional; when supplied the owner's
            ageBand is derived from it relative to the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares
            its household (same last name and postcode), declaring it a genuine additional
            member rather than a duplicate. Only bypasses the duplicate block; the household
            link is assigned deterministically regardless. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                How to address the pet owner - the title followed by a space and the last
                name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Points start at 0 and accrue independently, +2 when an email address is present, +1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 once tenure reaches at least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from membershipPoints, 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted as 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so 1 July 2025 - 30 June 2026 is FY26).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode first (the region whose pinned range contains the postcode - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality resolves to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity fingerprint, the full lower-case SHA-256 hex of 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' where the email segment is empty when the owner has no email. Duplicate rejection (409) is keyed on this value.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on this owner's registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner shares an existing owner's household (same last name and postcode) with a different telephone number, otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same household, different telephone), present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: How the owner prefers to be contacted, 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the registration
                date - 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Only
                present when birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; deleting an owner sets it true while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - deleted
